### EmailMessage

Defined in: [src/convex/email-templates.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/email-templates.ts)

### EmailTemplateOverrides

```ts
type EmailTemplateOverrides = { [Name in EmailTemplateName]?: (data: EmailTemplateData<Name>, context: EmailRenderContext & { byDefault: (data: EmailTemplateData<Name>) => EmailMessage }) => EmailMessage | Promise<EmailMessage> };
```

Defined in: [src/convex/email-templates.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/email-templates.ts)

Overrides for any template in [EmailTemplates](#emailtemplates). Each gets the same
data and context as the default, and the default itself, already bound to
that context, so an override can keep the packaged body and change only
what it needs:
`invite: (data, { byDefault }) => ({ ...byDefault(data), subject: 'Join us' })`.
An override may be async; the packaged default never is.

### ALL\_EMAIL\_EVENTS

```ts
const ALL_EMAIL_EVENTS: readonly ["email.sent", "email.delivered", "email.delivery_delayed", "email.bounced", "email.complained", "email.opened", "email.clicked", "email.failed", "email.scheduled", "email.received", "email.suppressed", "contact.created", "contact.updated", "contact.deleted", "domain.created", "domain.updated", "domain.deleted"];
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/email.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/email.ts)

The provider's full webhook event catalog: every transactional delivery
state, plus the contact and domain events the marketing surface
(segments/contacts/broadcasts) generates. Broadcast sends surface as
`email.*` events carrying a `broadcast_id`.

## Functions

### escapeHtml()

```ts
function escapeHtml(value): string;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/email-templates.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/email-templates.ts)

Escape text for HTML: `&`, `<`, `>`, `"` and `'`. Every packaged template
runs each value through it; an override that writes its own HTML should do
the same with anything a user typed (a name, a workspace name, a gift
message), or that user can put markup into an email your domain sends.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `value` | `string` |

#### Returns

`string`

#### Example

```ts
gift: (data, { byDefault }) => ({ ...byDefault(data), html: `<p>${escapeHtml(data.message ?? '')}</p>` })
```

***

### setupEmail()

```ts
function setupEmail(components, options?): Email;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/email.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/email.ts)

App-facing email helper over the `backend` component's email module: both
**transactional** email (send / status / cancel + webhook) and **marketing**
email (segments / contacts / broadcasts via the provider SDK). It also
holds the templates of every email the package sends: `setupAuth` and
`setupBilling` take this instance as their `email` option and send through
it, so an override here restyles all of them.

Both use the required `EMAIL_API_KEY` env var. While it's missing (e.g. a
mid-configuration preview), transactional `send` logs instead of delivering.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `components` | [`EmailComponents`](#emailcomponents) |
| `options` | [`SetupEmailOptions`](#setupemailoptions) |

#### Returns

[`Email`](#email-6)

#### Example

```ts
import { setupEmail } from 'nuxt-backend/email'
import { components } from './_generated/api'

export const email = setupEmail(components, {
  templates: { invite: (data, { byDefault }) => ({ ...byDefault(data), subject: 'Join the team' }) },
})
export const { getEmailStatus } = email.api
```
